author: Mistaa_Mitraa
body:
Dear Avicus,
I am very sorry that i let my friend use my account this will never happen again and i really love your server. Please could you find it in your heart to unban me. I would greatly apprecciate it.



Yours Sincerely Mistaa Mitraa
